Headline: Indonesia’s President Prabowo replaces Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa with deputy Suahasil Nazara
Market Impact: Mixed initially; credibility and policy-continuity test
Affected Market: IHSG; IDR; Indonesian bonds; banks; rate-sensitive stocks
Ticker: BBCA; BBRI; BMRI; BBNI; TLKM; ASII
AIRS Relevance: Major policy/credibility event. Monitor fiscal discipline, capital flows, bond yields and Rupiah.
New Development: Leadership transition confirmed; new minister pledged fiscal discipline and 3% GDP deficit cap.
AIRS Watchlist Impact: Increase macro risk penalty; prioritize strong-flow large caps only until market digests transition.
Catalyst Risk: Risk: policy uncertainty / fiscal credibility. Catalyst: credible continuity and investor reassurance.

Headline: Ousted finance minister says removal came amid instability and policy disagreements

Catalyst Risk: Risk: renewed capital outflows. Catalyst: clear fiscal framework.
